quiz.question_id: Mengapa penting selalu memanggil defer resp.Body.Close()?
quiz.question_en: Why is it important to always call defer resp.Body.Close()?
options_id: Agar koneksi TCP dikembalikan ke pool dan tidak terjadi resource leak
options_en: So the TCP connection is returned to the pool and no resource leak occurs
So the response can be read
So the status code can be accessed
So the request can be cancelled

quiz.question_id: Mengapa tidak boleh menggunakan http.DefaultClient di production?
quiz.question_en: Why should you NOT use http.DefaultClient in production?
options_id: http.DefaultClient tidak memiliki timeout, sehingga bisa hang selamanya
options_en: http.DefaultClient has no timeout, so it can hang forever

quiz.question_id: Cara membuat HTTP request dengan custom header di Go?
quiz.question_en: How do you make an HTTP request with a custom header in Go?
options_id: http.NewRequest lalu req.Header.Set(key, value) lalu client.Do(req)
options_en: http.NewRequest then req.Header.Set(key, value) then client.Do(req)
